1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // ----- Game objects -----
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: canvas.width / 2,
14:     y: canvas.height - 60,
15:     angle: -Math.PI / 2,
16:     radius: 12,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:     thrust: false,
20:     rotation: 0,
21:     health: 3,
22:   };
23: 
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
26:   let lastSpawn = 0;
27:   let lastTime = performance.now();
28:   let gameOver = false;
29: 
30:   // ----- Input -----
31:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => (ship.thrust = true));
32:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => (ship.thrust = false));
33:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => (ship.thrust = false));
34:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
35:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
36:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
37:     const cx = canvas.width / 2;
38:     const deadZone = 20;
39:     if (mx < cx - deadZone) ship.rotation = -0.07;
40:     else if (mx > cx + deadZone) ship.rotation = 0.07;
41:     else ship.rotation = 0;
42:   });
43: 
44:   // ----- Helpers -----
45:   function spawnAsteroid() {
46:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
47:     const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
48:     const y = -size;
49:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
50:     const angle = Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4; // mostly downwards
51:     asteroids.push({ x, y, size, speed, angle });
52:   }
53: 
54:   function update(dt) {
55:     // ship rotation & thrust
56:     ship.angle += ship.rotation;
57:     if (ship.thrust) {
58:       const thrustPower = 0.1;
59:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
60:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
61:     }
62:     // apply friction
63:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
64:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
65:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
66:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
67:     // wrap around edges
68:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
69:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
70:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
71:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
72: 
73:     // asteroids
74:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const a = asteroids[i];
76:       a.x += Math.cos(a.angle) * a.speed * dt;
77:       a.y += Math.sin(a.angle) * a.speed * dt;
78:       // remove off‑screen
79:       if (a.y - a.size > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // collisions
83:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const a = asteroids[i];
85:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
86:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
87:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
88:       if (dist < a.size + ship.radius) {
89:         ship.health--;
90:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
91:         if (ship.health <= 0) gameOver = true;
92:       }
93:     }
94: 
95:     // spawn new asteroids
96:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
97:       spawnAsteroid();
98:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   function draw() {
103:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
104:     // ship
105:     ctx.save();
106:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
107:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
108:     ctx.beginPath();
109:     ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
110:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
111:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
112:     ctx.closePath();
113:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.thrust ? 'orange' : 'white';
114:     ctx.fill();
115:     ctx.restore();
116:     // asteroids
117:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
118:     asteroids.forEach((a) => {
119:       ctx.beginPath();
120:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     });
123:     // health
124:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
125:     for (let i = 0; i < ship.health; i++) {
126:       ctx.fillRect(10 + i * 20, 10, 15, 5);
127:     }
128:     // game over
129:     if (gameOver) {
130:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
131:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
133:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
134:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
135:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
136:     }
137:   }
138: 
139:   function loop(timestamp) {
140:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 16; // approximate 60fps factor
141:     lastTime = timestamp;
142:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
143:     draw();
144:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
145:   })();
146: })();

(End of file - total 146 lines)
</content>
